dependencyCoverage: All 347 source Cargo.lock entries with registry checksums, including build/dev/other-target entries; closed conservative superset. Release workflow runs cargo build against the tagged checkout; it does not specify --locked. No independent build attestation is available.
binaryProvenance: Managed runtime uses the digest-verified official v0.1.4 Linux asset, not the existing Cargo-installed binary whose installation receipt omits dependency resolution. Tag, crates.io trusted-publishing SHA and local registry VCS metadata agree on resolvedCommit. Digest verification is not reproducible-build verification.
scope: global runtime, all 22 pinned tools available only in moodle-manager via the moodle skill
namespaceOverride: User explicitly requested MCP key moodle; runtime retains vendor-g36maid namespace.
backupPath: Original ~/.cargo/bin/moodle-mcp retained; no previous managed runtime.

securityReview.scope: Existing startup/config/REST/read/release/dependency review, plus source review of all 22 tool contracts, file conversion/download/upload, forum writes, submission save/finalization, messaging writes and raw Web Services dispatch. No upstream build or installation executed.
controls: Launcher forces MOODLE_READ_ONLY=0 and empty MOODLE_DISABLE_TOOLS for the user-approved full catalog
Only 22 exact current tools allowed in moodle-manager; only the moodle skill may be loaded; no shell/filesystem/browser/Task fallback
Global moodle_* denial retained; unknown future tools denied
Explicit Asia/Taipei timezone avoids the startup preference API request
Minimal env, hash/owner/mode-checked runtime; no browser/auth CLI invocation
Skill distinguishes drafts/submission/finalization and requires intended targets/content for writes; Build handles local preparation
limitations: Not an OS sandbox; file tools can read/write any OS-accessible path and do not enforce a workspace root; direct-tool denial and skill guidance do not confine MCP filesystem access
Downloads truncate existing destinations; failed streams can remove the destination or leave a partial file
File URLs can target external hosts; redirect confinement locks hostname rather than full origin/scheme/port and is not SSRF confinement
Raw Web Services calls can perform any operation the Moodle token permits; the local name allowlist check is skipped if the discovered function list is empty
Submissions, forum posts, messages and uploads act as the token owner; writes can partially succeed and retries can duplicate effects
Document conversion processes untrusted files; no conversion or transfer workload was executed in this scope expansion
No fresh registry vulnerability scan, reproducible-build verification or exact feature-pruned build graph verification performed
Dependency evidence pins the full source lockfile superset rather than proving every compiled crate from the binary

updatePolicy: Manual pinned source/dependency/release-artifact review and launcher pin change; no package manager at startup. Runtime copies are local artifacts, not included by Stow.
